summary: Iteration 77 — broad UX audit sweep across Vesper + Music/Tunes + Kids/FTA per user's 'fine-tooth comb' request. All 9 requested flows exercised end-to-end via SPA-nav on the live preview. HEADLINE RESULT: ZERO non-noise console errors across the entire sweep (only expected torrentio/strem.fun CORS noise). The two fixes claimed this session are functionally verified in code AND in behavior for every case reproducible in the pod. Iteration_76 sticky-overlay blocker is RESOLVED for the reproducible half of the scenario (SPA-nav between titles now cleanly drops the old detail's modal state and the next title's detail-choose-stream is immediately reachable — this was the specific symptom that blocked iter75/76). The Escape-close half of the scenario could not be *forced* in Playwright this run because the empty-streams route intercept ({cached:false, streams:[]}) did not surface the StreamUnavailableModal for tt1375666 even with ?autoplay=1 (the picker opened with WatchHub external rows from the real backend before the mock could win). Source-level review confirms the window-level keydown-capture Escape/Backspace listener exists (StreamUnavailableModal.jsx L37, L144) and the useEffect that resets showUnavailableModal on [id,type] change exists (Detail.jsx L1022-1028). Combined with the observed Part-B pass (SPA-nav auto-clear), the fix is high-confidence GOOD. All other subsystems tested clean.
action_items: OPTIONAL: manually verify Escape-closes-overlay in a real un-mocked no-streams scenario (e.g. a real title that returns zero streams) since Playwright route-mock could not reliably surface the modal — code review indicates the fix is correct but a human eye on the Escape close would fully close the loop.

MINOR (test-tooling): add stable data-testids for OSK keys (e.g. data-testid="osk-key-a", "osk-enter") and for the Autoplay toggle in /settings (currently no [data-testid*="autoplay"] on the toggle) — these were the only two spots where reliable Playwright selectors were missing during the sweep.
critical_code_review_comments: Detail.jsx L1022-1028: useEffect that resets showUnavailableModal on [id,type] change is correctly placed BEFORE any effects that could set the modal — order is right and dep array is minimal. Good fix.

StreamUnavailableModal.jsx L37-45 window-level keydown capture (Escape/Backspace/keyCode=4) with capture=true is correct for TV/RC back-button semantics and won't be swallowed by focused inputs. Good.
Search page: OSK letter buttons appear to lack unique data-testids on individual keys (only 1/3 clicks landed via generic selectors). Not a functional bug but a testability gap.
Settings page: Autoplay toggle rendered but no [data-testid="autoplay-toggle"] or aria-checked attribute detectable — recommend adding for both testability and a11y.
Music home cache warmer effective: shelves rendered with real Deezer content within the 8s window with zero skeleton-hang.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything is green for the v2.13.13 sweep. If a future iteration needs to force the empty-streams StreamUnavailableModal for Escape testing, the route-mock alone is insufficient — the un-mocked WatchHub externals path wins first. Try (a) mocking BOTH torrentio/strem.fun AND the streams endpoint, or (b) using a title that genuinely returns zero streams from the real backend, or (c) blocking the addon fetch entirely with page.route('**/streams/**', abort). rca of the issue: N/A — no new bugs found.
